name: Tokubetsu Settai ~Gokuraku Joudo e Youkoso~
original_name: 特別接待～極楽浄土へようこそ～
source:
Main character graduates from the National University and has all doors open before him, but he actually has to inherit hot springs resort after his father. On his hidden side he likes to prey on women. When a family of four people - mother and three daughters - arrive to the resort, he makes sure to prepare all his devices and traps to provide an enjoyable pastime.  

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角毕业于国立大学，一切都向他敞开，但他实际上必须继承父亲的温泉度假村。在他隐藏的一面，他喜欢掠夺女性。当一个四口之家（母亲和三个女儿）抵达度假村时，他确保准备好所有设备和陷阱，以提供愉快的消遣。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
